pages.title: Jewels Blitz 7
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Travel through a royal puzzle map in Jewels Blitz 7. Match at least three identical jewels and complete each board's objective with the help of boosters. Earn crowns for the Jewel Pass, then unlock the Endless Vault to pursue a higher score through successive chambers.

pages.title: SNACK & WARP
pages.creator: Henadzis Games
pages.description: Solve growing-worm puzzles in SNACK & WARP. Eat every apple, operate buttons, and move crates through portals before reaching the purple exit. Blade apples divide the worm into two controllable halves that can support objects, hold doors, or block saws across sixty-seven levels.

pages.title: Word Deck Solitaire
pages.creator: Yellow Bird Games
pages.description: Sort related words in Word Deck Solitaire. Select groups of three or four cards sharing a theme, property, object, or concept to uncover their hidden categories. Clear the full board as larger word sets introduce less obvious connections.

pages.title: Word Jam Association Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Classify vocabulary in Word Jam Association Puzzle. Drag words into the categories they belong to and work through the board's groups. Compare their meanings carefully when several answers appear to share a similar theme.

pages.title: Thread Sort
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Organize yarn colors in Thread Sort. Move a spool's top thread onto matching strands or an empty peg until each spool holds one shade. Completed colors feed the automatic stitching activity, gradually revealing a cross-stitched picture.

pages.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2025
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Restore neglected vehicles in Car Mechanic Simulator 2025. Find broken cars, dismantle them, replace damaged parts, and rebuild their engines and bodies. Search for suitable spare parts and choose paint to finish each restored car.

pages.title: Sausage Flip Free
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Launch a flexible food hero in Sausage Flip Free. Tap to flip the sausage between vines, shelves, pots, and other supports while clearing hazards. Time the next launch to cross the level's finish line.

pages.title: Princess vs Shark
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Direct water through puzzles in Princess vs Shark. Move the keys controlling the flow and choose a route that helps the princess past the obstacles. Plan the releases carefully as later scenes become more complicated.

pages.title: Future War: Bot Battle in Space 3D
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Design mechanical troops in Future War: Bot Battle in Space 3D. Choose modules and weapons for customizable units, then deploy them in real-time battles. Earn upgrade points during combat and use them to research further equipment for the next army design.

pages.title: Farm Block
pages.creator: Supercode Games
pages.description: Free animals from the enclosure in Farm Block. Slide animal-shaped blocks to open space and arrange useful matches along the route. Clear the obstacles in the right order to rescue every animal and finish the level.

pages.title: Jelly Tower CRUSH
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Bring down a soft structure in Jelly Tower CRUSH. Tap jelly matching the ball's color to remove it and cause connected sections to collapse. Complete the objective within the move limit, using bombs when a large area needs clearing.

pages.title: Geometry Vibes
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Keep an arrow on course in Geometry Vibes. Hold the button to rise and release it to dive around incoming spikes and traps. Choose level-based, endless, or race play, with shared-keyboard contests supporting two, three, or four players.

pages.title: We Will Not Survive
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Protect a settlement in We Will Not Survive. Harvest resources and upgrade weapons while the base faces repeated zombie waves. Use the mouse to manage improvements and adjust the attack speed when you want to change the pace.

pages.title: Escape Ancient Egypt
pages.creator: Rabbit Bay Games
pages.description: Open a route through ruins in Escape Ancient Egypt. Examine the rooms and solve their puzzles to unlock successive doors. Use mouse interactions to work through the ancient setting and escape the pharaoh's curse.

pages.title: Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Grow a collection of produce in Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game. Drop identical fruits so they collide and combine into larger ones. Manage the container's limited space while working toward the biggest fruit you can make without an overflow.

pages.title: Two Carts - Downhill
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Control two downhill runs in Two Carts - Downhill. Steer each cart separately with its corresponding arrow key while collecting components and avoiding hazards. Pick up ice or shields for help as the game speeds up and the dual routes become harder to manage.

pages.title: Cute Rabbit's Challenging Adventure
pages.creator: ans32game
pages.description: Guide a small animal through Cute Rabbit's Challenging Adventure. Move past hazards and defeat the enemies along five course sections. Use the arrow keys or on-screen controls to handle the next obstacle and continue the journey.

pages.title: Popcorn Fun Factory
pages.creator: Liones Games
pages.description: Develop a snack business in Popcorn Fun Factory. Start with a small production setup, unlock more lines, and introduce new popcorn flavors. Use the idle factory's growing output to continue expanding the operation.

pages.title: Pool Master 3D
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Pocket balls in a specific order in Pool Master 3D. Swipe to send the white ball into the others and knock them into the holes. Clear the colored targets before finally sending the white ball into a pocket itself.

pages.title: Tennis Open 2024
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Compete on major tennis courts in Tennis Open 2024. Practice in training mode, then enter matches and try to defeat the opponent. Spend the rewards earned through play on improvements to the tennis player.

pages.title: Gang Brawlers
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fight through street encounters in Gang Brawlers. Break boxes, pick up useful objects, and collect coins for character upgrades. Play the adventure with a friend or face one another in the separate two-player fighting mode.

pages.title: Save the Baby. Home Rush
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Reunite parents and children in Save the Baby. Home Rush. Draw a route from each parent to the child of the same color. Avoid walls, traffic, dogs, thieves, and paths that make the parents collide so every child reaches home safely.

pages.title: Ultimate Sudoku
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Fill number grids in Ultimate Sudoku. Place digits one through nine without repeating any within a row, column, or three-by-three box. Choose whether to select the cell or number first, and use note mode to record possible answers.

pages.title: Butterfly Connect
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Free insects by matching their wings in Butterfly Connect. Select identical pieces that are adjacent or joined by a route with at most two turns. Clear the field quickly and use freeze or hint tools when the arrangement needs help.

pages.title: Infinite Heroes
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Guide a hero card through danger in Infinite Heroes. Choose among eight character types and plan encounters with monsters, artifacts, spells, and portals. Collect loot while adapting your route as the opposition becomes stronger through the levels.

pages.title: Yatzy Arena
pages.creator: LazyLand SA
pages.description: Build better dice combinations in Yatzy Arena. Roll up to three times per turn and hold any results worth keeping before the next throw. Choose which scoring opportunities to pursue and finish with a higher total than the other player.

pages.title: Car Crash Simulator
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Test vehicles across different maps in Car Crash Simulator. Set up collisions or take on rivals and watch how the cars break apart. Use nitro, braking, slow motion, and camera options to change the setup of the next impact.

pages.title: Box Size
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Set the right dimensions in Box Size. Use the mouse to grow the cube and release it when it fits the landing space. Judge the gap before stopping the size adjustment to clear each successive challenge.

pages.title: Fill Fridge
pages.creator: Straydog Studio
pages.description: Pack groceries into a limited space in Fill Fridge. Drag food items into the refrigerator and arrange them so the full selection fits. Consider each item's shape before placing it where it might block another piece.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Clear colored formations in Bubble Shooter Colors Game. Aim a shot to create a cluster of at least three matching bubbles and pop it. Keep finding useful groups among the remaining pieces to work through the board.

pages.title: Laser Cannon Levels Pack
pages.creator: HyperCarrot
pages.description: Remove monsters with environmental attacks in Laser Cannon Levels Pack. Move and aim the cannon, use ricochets or explosive barrels, and hold the mouse button for a stronger shot. Find a firing solution for every creature in the physics puzzles.

pages.title: Heroes of Mangara. The Frost Crown
pages.creator: NOXGAMES
pages.description: Lead heroes across a northern island in Heroes of Mangara. The Frost Crown. Choose a party, place defenses, and use spells to fight toward the ancient artifact. Spend earned talent points on abilities and adjust between attacking and healing as each battle develops.

pages.title: Boxie Fly Up
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Climb through a colorful course in Boxie Fly Up. Tap to reverse Boxie's direction and avoid a collision as the character rises. Keep reacting to the approaching obstacles to reach a greater height on the next attempt.

pages.title: Ball Sort Xmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Separate colored balls in Ball Sort Xmas. Select a tube's top ball and transfer it onto a ball of the same color in another tube. Plan the movements until every tube contains a single color.

pages.title: Parking Man
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Earn your way as an attendant in Parking Man. Click or tap to guide cars into available spaces while avoiding the lot's obstacles. Park every vehicle without damage to complete the task.

pages.title: Christmas Puzzle
pages.creator: tegagame.com
pages.description: Clear festive block arrangements in Christmas Puzzle. Fit the pieces into complete horizontal rows or vertical columns without leaving holes in the line. Keep organizing the available space so the remaining blocks can be placed.

pages.title: Wild West Zombie Clash
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Survive an undead gunfight in Wild West Zombie Clash. Use modern guns and grenades to stop zombie hordes in a western setting. Finish rounds alive to unlock more weapons and prepare for the next assault.

pages.title: Tunnel Race
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Guide a small circle through passages in Tunnel Race. Avoid beams, obstacles, and the white boundary lines while collecting balls along the route. Use the mouse or swipe to steer through the safe spaces.

pages.title: impostor Game Console
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Help a traveler find his partner in impostor Game Console. Click or tap to jump through twenty different levels and their obstacles. Time each leap to keep the character's search moving forward.

pages.title: Green Mover
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Gather every star in Green Mover. Send the green ball along the level, remembering that it stops only when it reaches a solid object. Plan the order of moves across forty layouts so each star can be collected.

pages.title: Dead Zone Sniper
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Clear a hazardous site in Dead Zone Sniper. Use the scoped rifle to eliminate hazmat soldiers while staying alive within the mission timer. Move, aim, and reload carefully to complete the assignment and unlock the next level.

pages.title: Pizza maker cooking and baking games for kids
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Prepare a meal in Pizza maker cooking and baking games for kids. Mix the dough ingredients, roll the base, cut vegetables, and make the sauce. Add your chosen toppings and bake the pizza to finish the cooking sequence.

pages.title: Majestic Hero
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pull the right swords in Majestic Hero. Remove the barriers in an order that lets the hero claim treasure or reach the princess safely. Examine what each sword is holding back before opening another part of the puzzle.

pages.title: EvoWorld.io
pages.creator: Pixel Voices
pages.description: Evolve from a small insect in EvoWorld.io. Explore different biomes, eat suitable food to gain experience, and survive encounters with other players. Keep developing toward later forms while competing for a higher place on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Toddler Jigsaw
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Assemble pictures of small children in Toddler Jigsaw. Use the mouse to move the puzzle pieces into their matching positions. Compare the image details and edges until the chosen scene is complete.

pages.title: Buggy Racer Stunt Driver Buggy Racing 2k20
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Take a dune buggy onto stunt courses in Buggy Racer Stunt Driver Buggy Racing 2k20. Drive over ramps, handle drifts, and keep control through changing track sections. Complete the racing and stunt challenges with the selected vehicle.

pages.title: Drive Two Wheels Simulator Game 2020
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Balance a vehicle on one side in Drive Two Wheels Simulator Game 2020. Use the arrow keys to control the car while driving on two wheels. Try the available vehicle styles and judge how their handling affects the stunt.

pages.title: Line Puzzle Game
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Trace the connections between dots in Line Puzzle Game. Plan a continuous route through the figure and cover the required lines without drawing one twice. Consider the branches before choosing where to begin the stroke.

pages.title: Tank VS Tiles
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Select matching ammunition in Tank VS Tiles. Fire blue shots at blue tiles and pink shots at pink ones as targets approach the tank. Tap the corresponding side to choose the correct bullet color and clear the incoming pieces.

pages.title: SuperCar Racing
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Race through city traffic in SuperCar Racing. Use the arrow keys to steer, find space between other vehicles, and avoid a crash. Keep the car moving through the packed streets as you work toward winning the race.

pages.title: Ball Jump
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Steer a bouncing sphere in Ball Jump. Move left or right with clicks or the arrow keys to keep the ball clear of holes. Judge the next landing as it continues jumping along the route.

pages.title: Army Fps Shooting
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Eliminate rebels at hostile bases in Army Fps Shooting. Move through each location, collect ammunition, and use aimed fire to stop the armed opponents. Sprint, crouch, or jump to change position as you complete the shooting mission.

pages.title: Amazing Animals Jigsaw
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Restore wildlife pictures in Amazing Animals Jigsaw. Drag each scattered piece onto its matching location in the image. Use the animals' details and the shapes of the edges to complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Tank vs Tiles
pages.creator: GameNing
pages.description: Defend with two ammunition colors in Tank vs Tiles. Touch the left or right side to fire the corresponding blue or pink bullet. Match each shot to the incoming tile's color to destroy it before it reaches the tank.

pages.title: Maya Adventure
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Explore pyramids together in Maya Adventure. Collect diamonds to open doors and use ancient weapons against the enemies along the route. Cooperate with a friend across sixteen levels, using each character's movement and combat controls.

pages.title: Xmas Match 3
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Clear seasonal presents in Xmas Match 3. Make groups of at least three identical gifts to remove them and keep the matching puzzle moving. Look for the next useful combination among the pieces left on the board.

pages.title: Christmas Time Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare festive scenes in Christmas Time Difference. Find five changed details between the two nearly identical pictures. Select each difference with the mouse or touch controls and try to complete the search in less time.

pages.title: Halloween Knife Hit
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Break rotating targets in Halloween Knife Hit. Throw blades into the circles, gather pumpkins, and defeat bosses to unlock more knives. Time each launch around the knives already embedded in the target.

pages.title: Hallowen Devil Blast
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Link matching pieces in Hallowen Devil Blast. Click and drag a line through identical jewels to clear their group. Choose another connection among the remaining pieces to continue the seasonal matching challenge.

pages.title: Geometry Dash Finally
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Time jumps through three courses in Geometry Dash Finally. Click or tap to carry the character through the Cosmic, Aurora, and Finally levels. Retry a section when needed and work toward clearing it in fewer attempts.

pages.title: Flashy Fireworks
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Set off colorful bursts in Flashy Fireworks. Use mouse taps and swipes to interact with the fireworks as they appear. Keep responding to the next launch through the arcade challenge.

pages.title: My Dream Dentist
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Care for young patients in My Dream Dentist. Choose the correct dental tools and work through the problems in each child's mouth. Follow the treatment activities to finish the appointment.

pages.title: Goldie Sauna Flirting
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help prepare a date in Goldie Sauna Flirting. Complete a spa routine, shower, and outfit change before joining Goldie's boyfriend in the steam room. Choose their conversations and kisses, then dress her for the evening's next outing.

pages.title: Dead Target Zombie Shooter
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Fight an advancing horde in Dead Target Zombie Shooter. Move around the area, shoot zombies, and switch among six weapon choices. Use running, jumps, and the time-slowing control to respond to the attackers.

pages.title: Water Bus Island Simulator
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Drive between island checkpoints in Water Bus Island Simulator. Use WASD to steer the bus across the map and through water sections. Reach the required points to finish each level's route.

pages.title: Treasure Warriors
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Gather valuables in Treasure Warriors. Move through platform stages, jump past opposing warriors, and avoid the obstacles protecting the loot. Collect all the treasure while working toward a better score and completion of each level.

pages.title: Space Prison Escape
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Help two captives leave an alien craft in Space Prison Escape. Cooperate through the shuttle's platforms and hazards to locate the exit door. Use the characters' different movement options, including double jumps and wall hangs, to open a way through.

pages.title: Space Fighter
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Pilot through continuous combat in Space Fighter. Move the ship with the arrow keys while fighting across the side-scrolling route. Keep responding to the opposing forces as the endless shooting run continues.

pages.title: EG Fruit Slasher
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Cut airborne produce in EG Fruit Slasher. Use mouse or touch gestures to slice every fruit before it drops away. Avoid the bombs mixed into the launches while keeping up with the next group.

pages.title: Jewel Crush
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Meet collection targets in Jewel Crush. Match gems within a limited move count and complete the board's objective to earn stars. Row and column clears, bombs, and snowflakes can help through more than thirty puzzle levels.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Break a traveling chain in Bubble Shooter. Hold to aim and release a colored ball into the line, making groups of at least three matching bubbles to remove them. Use special bubbles with effects such as explosions, freezing, or reversing the chain's movement.

pages.title: European Football Jersey Quiz
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Pair national symbols in European Football Jersey Quiz. Match each flag with the correct football shirt, or work from a shirt back to its flag. Remember the revealed designs and complete the pairings as quickly as possible.

pages.title: Stack the Pancake
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Build a breakfast tower in Stack the Pancake. Drag each pancake out of the pan and place it on the plate or the pile above it. Balance the layers to keep the growing stack stable and improve its height.

pages.title: Boys Names Hangman
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Reveal first names in Boys Names Hangman. Choose letters to complete the hidden boy's name while avoiding too many incorrect guesses. Work out the remaining spelling before the hanging figure is completed.

pages.title: Boj Coloring Book
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Decorate character drawings in Boj Coloring Book. Choose a Boj-themed template, adjust the brush size, and paint with the available colors. Save the completed picture or print it when you want a copy of the artwork.

pages.title: Hungry Fridge
pages.creator: Enclave Games
pages.description: Feed the right items in Hungry Fridge. Select the food the refrigerator currently wants as the choices appear around it. Keep checking its preference and supply suitable meals to build a higher score.

pages.title: Box Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Fit a falling piece in Box Challenge. Adjust the box so it can pass into the opening and remain supported on the second ledge. Avoid making it so small that it drops through the lower gap.

pages.title: Unicorn Diamonds
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Help restore a magical land in Unicorn Diamonds. Select groups of at least three identical gems to remove them and add points. Work through the levels with power-ups as you search for the unique diamond needed to save the unicorns' home.

pages.title: Will you be my Monstertine?
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help a student find a Valentine's partner in Will you be my Monstertine? Choose Jackson Jekyll, Porter Geiss, or Slow Moe, then style the selected character. Put together an outfit before the search for a date at Monster High.

pages.title: Ski Rush Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Ski downhill in Ski Rush Game. Move the mouse or your finger to choose the skier's direction around obstacles. Gather flags for extra points and keep descending for as long as possible.

pages.title: Let Them Fall
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Guide several falling characters in Let Them Fall. Make each stickman drop and jump at the right moments to avoid obstacles. Choose among five difficulty modes and handle up to six characters yourself or share the controls with friends.

pages.title: Zombie Go Go Go
pages.creator: jeux-mini.com
pages.description: Help undead characters travel through a graveyard in Zombie Go Go Go. Jump over or pass beneath tombstones while gathering gold coins. Spend the coins on more zombies and avoid using up the limited chances to continue.

pages.title: Piano Time 2 Html5
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Explore a musical keyboard in Piano Time 2 Html5. Play the piano and try activities involving numbers, animals, and fruits. Use the interactive keys to make sounds while learning the different themed choices.

pages.title: Royal BFFs Pregnant Check up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Join two princesses for Royal BFFs Pregnant Check up. Follow the appointment's activities with the ultrasound and other examination tools. After the visit, prepare a fruit shake and decorate their bellies with colorful temporary designs.

pages.title: Princess Catwalk Magazine
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Create three cover outfits in Princess Catwalk Magazine. Choose a dress design for each photo shoot and match it with shoes and accessories. Coordinate the pieces so every magazine look has its own finished style.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Pregnant Check Up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help with a final prenatal visit in Dotted Girl Pregnant Check Up. Follow the game's prompts to check temperature, pulse, and the baby using the examination equipment. Complete the remaining care activities before the character's due date.
